title: 出光时，双手放在外面（国内版）

points.K4: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料

points.K7: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险
points.S1: 出光前，确认人和手都离开

shots.scene: 欣欣站在激光切割机旁，举起两只手掌
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside a laser cutting machine and holds up both open palms.
shots.narration: 这一课讲：出光时手放哪儿。

shots.scene: 两只手图标放在机器外的两个按钮上，切割头在远处
shots.prompt_en: An icon of two hands resting on two buttons outside the machine, with the cutting head far away. No people.
shots.narration: 答案是：两只手都在外面。

shots.scene: 阿杰在老李指导下准备对中切割头，想用手指去扶喷嘴下的工件
shots.prompt_en: Under the facility engineer's guidance, the young male student prepares to center the cutting head and reaches a finger under the nozzle to hold a part.
shots.narration: 阿杰想用手指扶住喷嘴下的工件。

shots.scene: 老李一把拦住阿杰的手
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer quickly stops the young male student's hand.
shots.narration: 老李一把拦住：手拿出来！

shots.scene: 阿杰挠头，一脸不解
shots.prompt_en: The young male student scratches his head, looking puzzled.
shots.narration: 阿杰不明白：就打一下，有那么险吗？

shots.scene: 切割头在钢板上安静地移动，只有细细的气流
shots.prompt_en: A cutting head moves quietly over a steel sheet with only a faint stream of air. No people.
shots.narration: 激光切割时，安安静静。

shots.scene: 安静的声音图标和盾牌图标之间打问号
shots.prompt_en: A quiet sound icon and a shield icon with a question mark between them. No people.
shots.narration: 听着温和，好像很安全。

shots.section_title: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化
shots.scene: 喷嘴下方小小的间隙放大图，金属变成蒸汽冒出
shots.prompt_en: A magnified diagram of the tiny gap under the nozzle, where metal turns into vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 可喷嘴下面那一点点空隙里，
overlay: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化

shots.section_title: 喷嘴下面，金属瞬间汽化
shots.scene: 金属块图标瞬间消失，变成一缕烟
shots.prompt_en: A metal block icon vanishes instantly into a wisp of vapor. No people.
shots.narration: 金属被瞬间汽化，非常剧烈。

shots.scene: 老李用对中用的空白胶带贴在喷嘴下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer sticks a blank piece of tape under the nozzle for lens centering, then withdraws his hand.
shots.narration: 对中镜片，要手动打一下光。

shots.scene: 老李双手分别按在机器外侧的两个按钮上
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses two buttons on the outside of the machine, one with each hand.
shots.narration: 出光时，两只手都按在外面的按钮上。

shots.scene: 一只手按钮、另一只手伸到喷嘴下的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of one hand on a button and the other hand under the nozzle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 绝不能一只手按，一只手在里面。

shots.section_title: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料
shots.scene: 一块厚厚的透明塑料块放在喷嘴下
shots.prompt_en: A thick clear plastic block placed under the nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 用一块厚透明塑料做个演示。
overlay: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料

shots.section_title: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料
shots.scene: 手指图标和塑料块图标比硬度，塑料块更硬
shots.prompt_en: A finger icon compared with a plastic block icon, with the block marked as harder. No people.
shots.narration: 它可比手指硬多了。

shots.section_title: 演示：打一块透明硬塑料
shots.scene: 老李双手按在外侧按钮上出光，切割头上方闪一下
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer presses the two outside buttons, and a brief flash appears at the cutting head.
shots.narration: 跟对中打点一样，只打一下。

shots.scene: 老李拿起塑料块，对着光看到一条贯穿的细孔
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer holds up the plastic block, showing a thin hole running all the way through it.
shots.narration: 光斑只有这么细，

shots.scene: 示意图：细光束从塑料块上面进、下面出
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a thin beam enters the top of the block and comes out the bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 却从上一直打穿到底。

shots.section_title: 这就是双手在外的原因
shots.scene: 手指图标放在光束路径上，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a finger placed in the beam path, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 要是换成手指，后果可想而知。
overlay: 这就是双手在外的原因

shots.section_title: 这就是双手在外的原因
shots.scene: 阿杰把两只手背到身后，点头
shots.prompt_en: The young male student puts both hands behind his back and nods.
shots.narration: 所以出光时，双手一定在外面。

shots.section_title: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险
shots.scene: 旧式切割头图标，两根手指垫在喷嘴下的画面被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an old-style cutting head with two fingers held under the nozzle, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 有人用手指垫在喷嘴下量高度。
overlay: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险

shots.section_title: 手指垫在喷嘴下，最危险
shots.scene: 手指图标一滑，滑进光束路径
shots.prompt_en: A diagram: a finger icon slips sideways into the beam path. No people.
shots.narration: 手指一滑，光就穿过去了。

shots.scene: 手指缠着绷带的图标，旁边一个疼痛符号
shots.prompt_en: An icon of a bandaged finger with a pain symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 不少人手指因此受伤，非常疼。

shots.scene: 垫块工具、量规和双手按钮三个图标，手指图标离得远远的
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a spacer tool, a gauge, and two-hand buttons, with a finger icon kept far away. No people.
shots.narration: 量高度用工具，手指别伸进去。

shots.section_title: 出光前，确认人和手都离开
shots.scene: 老李出光前环顾四周，示意小研退后
shots.prompt_en: Before firing, the facility engineer looks around and signals the female graduate student to step back.
shots.narration: 出光前，先看一圈。
overlay: 出光前，确认人和手都离开

shots.section_title: 出光前，确认人和手都离开
shots.scene: 老李喊话提醒，周围的人举手示意已离开
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer calls out a warning, and nearby people raise their hands to confirm they are clear.
shots.narration: 喊一声，确认大家都离开。

shots.section_title: 出光前，确认人和手都离开
shots.scene: 用胶带缠住一个按钮、改成单手出光的图标，被红叉划掉
shots.prompt_en: An icon of tape holding down one of the two buttons to fire with one hand, crossed out with a red X. No people.
shots.narration: 双手按钮不能绑住、改成单手。

shots.scene: 阿杰手背被烫到，小研马上停掉激光
shots.prompt_en: The young male student's hand gets a small burn and the female graduate student immediately stops the laser.
shots.narration: 万一被激光灼伤，先停激光。

shots.scene: 阿杰把手放在水龙头下用流动冷水冲
shots.prompt_en: The young male student holds his hand under cool running water at a sink.
shots.narration: 用流动的冷水冲，降温止痛。

shots.scene: 小研用干净纱布盖住伤处，旁边医院图标
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student covers the burn with clean gauze, next to a hospital icon.
shots.narration: 盖上干净纱布，别涂乱七八糟的东西。

shots.scene: 王老师接到电话，电话图标显示120
shots.prompt_en: The safety administrator answers a phone call, next to a phone icon showing 120.
shots.narration: 报告老师，及时就医，必要时拨120。

shots.scene: 老李拿起一块不明塑料板，翻看空白标签
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer picks up an unknown plastic sheet and checks its blank label.
shots.narration: 切之前，先弄清是什么材料。

shots.scene: 不明材料放上切割台的图标，被红叉划掉；旁边有毒烟雾图标
shots.prompt_en: An icon of an unknown material placed on the cutting table, crossed out with a red X, next to a toxic fumes icon. No people.
shots.narration: 有些塑料一切就冒有毒烟气。

shots.scene: 老李翻开允许加工材料清单，排烟风机开着
shots.prompt_en: The facility engineer checks a blank approved materials list while the fume extractor runs.
shots.narration: 按允许清单选材，排烟开着再切。

shots.scene: 欣欣身旁浮现双手按钮和安静的切割头图标
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands beside icons of two-hand buttons and a quiet cutting head.
shots.narration: 安静不等于安全，出光双手在外。

shots.scene: 塑料块贯穿细孔和手指打叉两个图标
shots.prompt_en: Two icons: a plastic block with a thin hole through it, and a crossed-out finger under a nozzle. No people.
shots.narration: 细细一束光，能穿透硬塑料。

shots.scene: 环顾确认、冷水冲洗、材料清单三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Three icons: a person looking around, cool running water, and a blank materials list. No people.
shots.narration: 出光前看一圈，灼伤冷水冲，材料先确认。

shots.scene: 欣欣和阿杰、老李一起把双手举起挥手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot, the young male student and the facility engineer wave goodbye with both hands raised.
shots.narration: 保护好双手，从每一次出光做起。
